reason_for_existing: Sets A-E never had standalone result JSONs. Their numbers were published in the round table only. Re-running the current engine on them would NOT reproduce these values: the taxonomy changed after round 6 and their labels were rewritten with those sets in view. This file mirrors the published numbers verbatim instead of manufacturing new ones.
warning: These are micro precision/recall against MODEL labels, measured with the engine as it existed at that round. They are levels in a sequence, not independent replications. Do not average them and do not compare them with set G or H.
